meta.title: SmartZone POS — The phone shop's ledger, by IMEI
meta.description: POS for mobile phone and accessories shops in Bangladesh: IMEI stock, sales, dues, installments, trade-ins and daily cash, in Bangla and English.

hero.title: Your shop's khata, one scan away
hero.sub: Every phone is known by its IMEI. Who bought it, for how much, what's still owed, when the warranty ends: scan it and it's all there. Built for mobile phone shops.
hero.note: No card needed. We help you set up.

demo.label: Scan an IMEI and see
demo.hint: A demo IMEI is filled in. Press Enter or tap Scan.
demo.notFound: That IMEI isn't in the demo. Try one of these.

khata.title: Dues written in a khata get lost. Not here.
khata.sub: Who owes what, for how long, and when they last paid is worked out for you. Remind them by SMS with one tap.
khata.paperCaption: Before: flipping pages, crossed-out lines, guesswork.
khata.appCaption: Now: sorted by amount and age, every taka accounted for.

day.title: A day at the counter, start to finish
day.sub: From opening the cash drawer in the morning to matching it at night, in one place.

steps.title: Cash drawer opened
steps.body: Session starts with a ৳5,000 float. Who sat at the counter, and when, is recorded.

steps.title: An A15 sold
steps.body: Scan the IMEI on the box, add the customer's number, take part payment by bKash. The rest goes on their account. Invoice prints.

steps.title: An old due collected
steps.body: Karim bhai pays ৳1,500. A receipt prints and he gets an SMS.

steps.title: A used phone bought
steps.body: An iPhone 11 taken in exchange. Seller's NID, battery %, and grade recorded, and it's in stock.

steps.title: Cash matched
steps.body: The system expects ৳62,300 in the drawer. You count ৳62,300. Difference: zero.

features.title: Made for mobile phone shops
features.sub: What general shop software leaves out is exactly what a phone business needs most.

items.title: Every phone by IMEI
items.body: Dual IMEI, serial, purchase cost, which branch it's in: the full history of every unit.

items.title: Installments (EMI)
items.body: Down payment, due dates, guarantor, late fees. An SMS goes out before each due date.

items.title: Used phones and exchange
items.body: Buy in with the seller's NID and the phone's condition recorded, then apply it against a new sale.

items.title: Warranty claims
items.body: Scan the IMEI to see if it's under warranty. Track it from the service center and back to the customer.

items.title: Real profit
items.body: Profit uses each phone's own purchase cost, not an average guess.

items.title: Bangla invoices
items.body: 80mm thermal or A4. Every phone's IMEI and warranty are printed on the invoice.

items.title: Multiple branches
items.body: Stock and cash per branch, and stock transfers between branches.

items.title: Staff permissions
items.body: Decide how much discount a cashier can give and whether they see cost prices.

pricing.title: Priced for the size of your shop
pricing.sub: Every plan starts with 14 days free. Pay monthly or yearly with bKash or Nagad.

items.a: It runs online and works well on mobile data. Pages are light, so it stays usable on a slow connection.

items.q: Will my scanner and printer work?
items.a: Any USB or Bluetooth barcode scanner and any 80mm thermal printer works. We help you set them up.

items.q: How long does moving from the khata take?
items.a: Import products and IMEIs from Excel in one go. Enter old dues as opening balances and you're running from day one.
It's backed up daily. Only your staff can see your shop's data, and you can download all of it at any time.
bKash, Nagad or card. Monthly or yearly.

items.q: What if I want to stop?
items.a: Cancel any time. Your data stays viewable and downloadable for 90 days after you cancel.

cta.title: Set up your shop today
cta.sub: Try it free for 14 days. We'll help you bring over your products and old dues.
